caption: The drawing depicts three separate textile samples, each bordered by fine lines and arranged on a rectangular, off-white background. The main and largest sample, centered at the top, is a geometric patchwork comprised of numerous hexagonal and strip-shaped fabric pieces in a variety of colors and patterns. These fabrics include solids, florals, stripes, and printed motifs and are predominantly colored in rich shades of red, blue, green, purple, brown, and gold. The top section of this patchwork features mostly hexagonal pieces stitched together closely, displaying blue, red, green, cream, and gold patterns; the lower section transitions to wider strips and some trapezoidal pieces in deep hues like dark green, navy, burnt orange, and lavender. The left corner beneath the main sample contains a single hexagonal swatch with a multi-colored, intricate design featuring a mix of floral and decorative patterns, predominantly in red, blue, green, and tan shades, outlined by a thin border. The right corner below the main sample showcases a right triangle of dark fabric decorated with white and gold circular motifs, suggesting berries or round fruit, and a light blue border is present along its longest edge. The overall composition is carefully framed, highlighting the diversity and texture of the different textile patterns and colors.
title: Silk Couch Cover
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
